Checked against the 28-row NW-district roster for duplicates: not a duplicate of, and clearly distinct from, the related-but-separate Volkhov-Segezha-Kostomuksha line (which one of the sheet's OWN existing citations -- ptzgovorit.ru -- turned out to actually be about, a citation-quality defect now corrected/dropped in the fills) and from Petrozavodsk-Kondopoga (P7560, which the sheet's Proposal-year citation, dp.ru, turned out to actually be about -- filed as a cross_row_lead). Diameter discrepancy: sheet records 720 mm; the only source found that states a diameter for this specific line (kss-spb.ru, independent vendor project page, directly names the pipeline) states 'Диаметр трубы 700 мм' = 700 mm -- a genuine 20 mm conflict, not a rounding artifact (both 700mm and 720mm are legitimate, distinct standard Russian trunk-pipe diameter classes). Could not find a second source stating either figure to adjudicate: the operator pages (Gazprom Transgaz St. Petersburg history + Volkhovskoye branch, both read via Wayback) do not state a diameter; the current_ref's openinframap.org OSM map layer could not be read for its diameter tag via available tools (Overpass API queries 406'd). Staged 700 mm as a candidate value in the Diameter fill per the single source found, but filing this as an open spec concern rather than a settled correction -- a Glavgosexpertiza approval document or a Gazprom technical passport for this specific 290 km branch would be needed to resolve which figure (700 or 720) is correct.
